records.source: Calculate diameters is off: a magnification change keeps every diameter as it is.
records.translation: Calcular diámetros está desactivado: un cambio de aumento conserva cada diámetro tal como está.

records.key: Pinned (bold): you set this diameter, so a magnification change keeps it. Clear the cell, or turn Calculate diameters off and on again, to calculate it from the magnification.
records.source: Pinned (bold): you set this diameter, so a magnification change keeps it. Clear the cell, or turn Calculate diameters off and on again, to calculate it from the magnification.
records.translation: Fijado (negrita): usted estableció este diámetro, así que un cambio de aumento lo conserva. Vacíe la celda, o desactive y vuelva a activar Calcular diámetros, para calcularlo a partir del aumento.
